posts.title: Building formbook at scale with a fleet of coding agents
posts.description: How 805 coding-agent runs on throwaway boxes took formbook from zero to 489 court-filing templates, mostly in two days, and what the data can't tell you.

posts.title: Why can't we do with the graviton what we did with the photon
posts.description: The mathematics of why integrating graviton momenta from zero to infinity produces infinities that cannot be absorbed by a finite set of counterterms — and why this is a fundamental, structural problem.

posts.title: Lessons from Markets on Decision Making
